name: jvm_callgraph_build
title: jvm.callgraph_build
description: Construct a call graph from compiled bytecode via OPAL. Returns a HANDLE — a call graph has millions of edges and must never enter agent context. Entry points come from the BuildRecipe; wrong entry points produce a structurally valid, analytically worthless graph. SootUp IS the engine here — OPAL was dropped because it is built against Scala 3.7 while this project is on the 3.3 LTS and TASTy is not forward compatible — so there is no second implementation to cross-check against.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.

sootUpDisagreements.description: Edges present in one backend and absent in the other.
